builds.howItPlays: You play cheap units every turn, using the extra energy Darius gives you after your first card to get a second one down, and attack both battlefields early. Kennen, Keeper of Balance can Stun a blocker so it deals no combat damage, while Against the Odds (+2 Might for each enemy unit in the fight) or B.F. Sword (+3 Might) makes one attacker big enough to win.
builds.whyYou: You like starting the fight from turn one and keeping your opponent busy answering your units instead of building their own plan. You enjoy the quick calls this deck asks for each turn: which cheap unit to play first so Darius pays for the second, which blocker Kennen should Stun, which attacker gets the sword. You don't mind that your units are small and your hand runs out, because you plan to have most of your points before your opponent's expensive cards arrive. If short games won by never letting up sound fun, this Darius suits you.

builds.howItPlays: You fill the board with cheap units like Honest Broker, which leaves you Gold when it dies, then use Baited Hook (3 cost) to kill one of your own units and play a unit with up to 1 more Might from the top five cards of your deck for free. Spectral Matron brings back a unit costing 3 or less from your trash when you play her, so the units you trade away keep returning while you hold both battlefields.
builds.whyYou: You like a board that keeps growing, and you don't mind losing your own units if each one turns into something bigger. You enjoy the choices this deck asks for each turn: which small unit to feed to the Hook, when to use Darius's extra energy to play two cards, which unit Spectral Matron should bring back. You're fine with a little luck in what the top of your deck offers, because you get five cards to choose from and plenty of spare units to try again. If turning your weakest units into your best ones sounds fun, this Darius suits you.
